reproduce: cargo build --release -p docmonk-cli (at the baseline commit); DOCMONK_P0_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:9201 scripts/p0-baseline.sh target/release/docmonk out.json 20 4000 opensearch
findings: storage.mode=server indexed into 20 local SQLite knowledge.db files and wrote 0 records to any OpenSearch index
server-mode search returned results read from local SQLite (silent local fallback)
server-mode status reported no server counts (placeholder error in docmonk-service status.rs)
sources were indexed serially under one global index.lock
notes: Small corpus (20 sources, 4000 generated files plus document fixtures in every tenth repository) on a shared 4-vCPU container; timings are a baseline for the same harness and host only, not a performance claim. The full 150-source/200000-file run uses the same script with 150 200000.
